attributes.description: Overview of threat detections reported by Upwind.

embeddableConfig.content:
This dashboard gives visibility into the threat detections data stream of Upwind, showing security detections raised across cloud accounts and workloads. It highlights total detections, trends of detections over time by severity and by detection type, and status and category breakdowns. It surfaces the most affected resources and workload namespaces, with a stream of the latest detections for triage. Use the controls above to filter by detection type, severity, status, and cloud provider. Together, these panels offer a detection-level view to support security monitoring, triage, and response.

**[Integration Page](/app/integrations/detail/upwind/overview)**
